regime_context: Canada/TSX shows a broad, non-directional rotation: half the universe is still trend-eligible, but the leader (Oil & Gas, XEG.TO) is crowded and only mixed-trend, while the next three are precious/base metals with weak breadth (0.27 or lower). The absolute-trend gate does help here, but my own directional accuracy is poor (0.343 over 99 calls), so conviction must default low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Gold Miners (XGD.TO, rank 2, score 1.11) can hold its rank-2 position and push the rotation margin below 0.15 while its breadth expands above 0.4 — a confirmed handoff would require both Gold rising and Oil stalling simultaneously; a single week of Oil re-asserting dominance with the margin widening back above 0.6 retires this watch.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks (ZEB.TO) are the only non-resource theme with a clean 'trend' Hurst tag, a mid durability bar (0.59) and no crowding (z -0.01). It sits outside the crowded energy/precious-metals complex and is scorable. This is a relative-steadiness lean, not a momentum call: rank 5 is unremarkable, but the trend-gate leg supports staying power and the crowding leg is neutral-to-supportive.
evidence: hurst_tag: 'trend' vs 'mixed' or 'mean-revert' for most leaders
theses.dissent: The score (0.423) is far behind the commodity leaders and breadth is tiny (0.143); if the broad rotation is genuinely into resources, banks give up relative performance cleanly.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO lags XEG.TO by 8% over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas is the dominant narrative by score and weight, but it is crowded (z 1.04), its trend health is only 'mixed', and the rotation radar shows margin over Gold shrinking with absorption at 0.31. Per the guardrails, crowding is a cap/size-down caution, NOT a fade and NOT a short — leaning 'avoid' respects the documented failure mode of fading the leader while declining to add to a crowded, mixed-trend theme.
theses.dissent: It is still rank 1 with the highest score (1.612) and the best breadth (0.786); trending energy regimes can stay crowded longer than anyone expects, and avoiding it forfeits the strongest relative momentum.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO makes a new 20-day relative high vs the S&P/TSX and crowding_z falls below 0.5
